ns2:course.label: Psych for Med Stu & Hlth Prf
ns2:course.description: Advanced treatment of psychological concepts with an emphasis on their interaction with medicine. Topics include: perception, learning, memory, thinking, emotions, and individual differences; psychological theories and data relevant to the analysis of illness and disease; decision making and medical problem solving. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Twelve hours of psychology and a 3.0 grade point average; and senior, graduate, or professional standing; or consent of instructor.
